prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1428; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist fracture that is consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Over the course of 17 visits, care followed a typical progression of immobilization, serial imaging, hand therapy, and gradually increasing range-of-motion work. Visit frequency tapered as the patient improved and was reduced to periodic follow-up once function returned toward baseline. On examination, localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the affected wrist support the reported injury, while neurovascular testing and the remaining orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote minor strain in the same region years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the current presentation. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicate entries.
